title: Revenue Management Standard: Counting Group Pickup on Group Room Blocks
content:
A Group Room Blocks pickup is a count of room nights, taken from the attendee reservations that name the block and are booked on a rate plan that counts as pickup for its block type.

### The count

1. **Window.** The block's nights run from the arrival date up to, but not including, the departure date. Where the block type counts shoulder nights at the group rate as pickup, the window is widened by the Group Block Rate shoulder nights. Pickup is read when the block is actualized or at the moment of handling.
2. **Reservations counted.** Reservations that name the block on a rate plan listed for the block type.
3. **Room nights contributed by each reservation:**
   - a checked-out or in-house reservation counts the nights between its actual check-in and actual check-out;
   - a no-show reservation that carries a no-show charge counts 1 room night where charged no-shows count as pickup;
   - a reservation the hotel relocated counts its booked nights where relocated reservations count as pickup;
   - a cancelled reservation counts 0.

### Block-type settings

| Block type | Rate plans counted as pickup | A charged no-show counts as one picked-up room night | Relocated reservations count for their booked nights | Shoulder nights at the group rate count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | No |
| Wedding Room Block | Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Sports Team Room Block | Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | No |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | No |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Association Convention Room Block | Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Worked count (hypothetical block)

A Corporate Meeting Room Block has these reservations naming it, all at the Group Block Rate: three checked-out reservations of 2 actual nights each (6), one no-show reservation carrying a no-show charge (1), one reservation the hotel relocated with 3 booked nights (3), and one cancelled reservation (0). Its pickup is 6 plus 1 plus 3 plus 0, that is 10 room nights. A further reservation at the same hotel on the same nights under a transient rate plan is not on a rate plan counted as pickup and adds nothing.
